text:
- Total revenue across all countries reached £162,343.01 TW, up 2.1% WoW from £158,963.14 LW.
- United Kingdom maintained rank 1 with revenue of £133,081.75 TW, representing 82.0% of total revenue TW, though declining 3.0% WoW.
- EIRE achieved rank 2 with revenue of £16,455.16 TW and 10.1% share TW, surging 395.9% WoW.
- Netherlands held rank 3 with revenue of £6,062.68 TW and 3.7% share TW, but fell 65.5% WoW from £17,594.55 LW.
- Germany recorded the largest WoW increase at 596.0%, growing from £407.67 LW to £2,837.23 TW.
- United Kingdom generated the most orders at 304 TW, down slightly from 308 LW.
